Package com.example.androidexample

Class GroupDetailFragment

java.lang.Object
androidx.fragment.app.Fragment
com.example.androidexample.GroupDetailFragment
All Implemented Interfaces:
android.content.ComponentCallbacks, android.view.View.OnCreateContextMenuListener, androidx.activity.result.ActivityResultCaller, androidx.lifecycle.HasDefaultViewModelProviderFactory, androidx.lifecycle.LifecycleOwner, androidx.lifecycle.ViewModelStoreOwner, androidx.savedstate.SavedStateRegistryOwner
public class GroupDetailFragment extends androidx.fragment.app.Fragment
Fragment that displays detailed information about a specific group.

Shows group name, capacity, and the most recent bill. Provides buttons to view all bills, view transactions, and navigate to bill details. Group and bill data are fetched via Retrofit from remote and local servers.
